contentBlocks.text: You must upload a rent statement so the court and the defendant can see the amount of rent arrears you are claiming

bullets: the dates and amounts of all missed payments
a running total of the rent arrears

contentBlocks.text: 1. Upload your rent statement now: Upload the rent statement that is up to date today.
2. Upload an updated statement: You must upload an updated rent statement the day before the hearing. It must include any new payments or arrears that have happened since your first statement.
The court will use your updated statement to make sure it has the most up to date information about the rent arrears you are claiming.
Give your document a name that explains what it is. For example, ‘Rent statement up to 16 May 2025’.
